```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(osmextract)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson"))

land_use_raw <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "spatial", "AmendmenttoMasterPlan2019LandUselayer.geojson"))

pbf_file <- here("data", "raw", "spatial", "malaysia-singapore-brunei-261113.osm.pbf")

area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r}
hub_jurong <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_tampines <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_woodlands <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hubs <- bind_rows(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)

hubs_4326 <- hubs %>% 
  st_transform(4326)

rm(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)
```

```{r}
jurong_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "JURONG EAST") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
jurong_bbox <- st_bbox(jurong_sf)

tampines_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "TAMPINES") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
tampines_bbox <- st_bbox(tampines_sf)

woodlands_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "WOODLANDS") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
woodlands_bbox <- st_bbox(woodlands_sf)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
interested_features <- list(
  "amenity" = c(
    "bar", "biergarten", "pub", "nightclub",
    "restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", "food_court",
    "cinema", "theatre", "arts_centre", "community_centre", "library"
  ),
  "shop" = c(
    "mall", "department_store", "clothes", "fashion", "shoes", "books", "electronics",
    "supermarket", "convenience", "bakery", "butcher", "greengrocer"
  ),
  "leisure" = c(
    "park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground"
  )
)

raw_points <- oe_read(
  file_path = pbf_file,
  layer = "points",
  extra_tags = c("amenity", "shop", "leisure"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

raw_polygons <- oe_read(
  file_path = pbf_file,
  layer = "multipolygons",
  extra_tags = c("amenity", "shop", "leisure"),
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  st_centroid(quiet = TRUE)

poi_collection <- bind_rows(raw_points, raw_polygons) %>%
  filter(
    amenity %in% interested_features$amenity |
    shop %in% interested_features$shop |
    leisure %in% interested_features$leisure
  ) %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  distinct(osm_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
poi_collection_hubs <- poi_collection %>%
  st_intersection(hubs_4326 %>% select(PLN_AREA_N)) %>%
  mutate(hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N)) %>%
  select(-PLN_AREA_N)

poi_collection_hubs <- poi_collection_hubs %>% 
  select(name, amenity, shop, leisure, hub, geometry)
```

```{r}
pois_classified <- poi_collection_hubs %>%
  mutate(
    poi_category = case_when(
      amenity %in% c("bar", "biergarten", "pub", "nightclub") ~ "Nightlife",
      amenity %in% c("restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", "food_court") ~ "Dining",
      amenity %in% c("cinema", "theatre", "arts_centre") | 
        leisure %in% c("park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground") ~ "Family_Leisure",
      shop %in% c("mall", "department_store", "clothes", "fashion", "shoes", "books", "electronics") ~ "Retail_Shopping",
      shop %in% c("supermarket", "convenience", "bakery", "butcher", "greengrocer") ~ "Daily_Needs",
      amenity %in% c("community_centre", "library") ~ "Community",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>% 
  filter(poi_category != "Other") %>% 
  select(
    poi_category, 
    geometry, hub, name
    ) %>% 
  arrange(poi_category)

poi_counts <- pois_classified %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hub, poi_category) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
    )
```

```{r}
hub_areas <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  st_transform(3414) %>% 
  group_by(PLN_AREA_N) %>% 
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry), 
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1000000,
    hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N)
  ) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

poi_density <- poi_counts %>%
  left_join(hub_areas, by = "hub") %>%
  mutate(
    density_per_km2 = count / area_km2
  )
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
land_use_3414 <- land_use_raw %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(3414)

rm(land_use_raw)

land_use_hubs <- st_intersection(
  land_use_3414,
  hubs %>%
    st_transform(3414) %>%
    select(PLN_AREA_N)
) %>%
  mutate(
    hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N)
  )
```

```{r}
land_use_hubs <- land_use_hubs %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1000000)

land_use_summary_raw <- land_use_hubs %>%
  group_by(hub, LU_DESC) %>%
  summarise(
    total_land_area = sum(area_km2), 
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  group_by(hub) %>%
  mutate(
    total_hub_area = sum(total_land_area),
    percentage = (total_land_area / total_hub_area) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hub, desc(percentage))
```

```{r}
land_use_summary_clean <- land_use_hubs %>%
  mutate(
    land_category = case_when(
      LU_DESC %in% c("RESIDENTIAL", "RESIDENTIAL WITH COMMERCIAL AT 1ST STOREY", 
                     "COMMERCIAL & RESIDENTIAL", "WHITE") ~ "Residential& Mixed-Use",
      LU_DESC %in% c("COMMERCIAL", "HOTEL", "BUSINESS 1", "BUSINESS 2", 
                     "BUSINESS PARK", "BUSINESS 1 - WHITE", "BUSINESS 2 - WHITE", 
                     "BUSINESS PARK - WHITE") ~ "Commercial/Business",
      LU_DESC %in% c("PARK", "OPEN SPACE", "SPORTS & RECREATION", "BEACH AREA") ~ "Leisure/Green",
      LU_DESC %in% c("EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION", "CIVIC & COMMUNITY INSTITUTION", 
                     "PLACE OF WORSHIP", "HEALTH & MEDICAL CARE",
                     "COMMERCIAL / INSTITUTION", "RESIDENTIAL / INSTITUTION") ~ "Community/Institutional",
      TRUE ~ "Other")
  ) %>%
  group_by(hub, land_category) %>%
  summarise(total_land_area = sum(area_km2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(hub) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (total_land_area / sum(total_land_area)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

land_use_summary_clean$land_category <- factor(
  land_use_summary_clean$land_category,
  levels = c("Residential& Mixed-Use", "Commercial/Business", 
             "Leisure/Green", "Community/Institutional", "Other")
)
```

```{r}
bus_weekend_sd <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "bus_weekend_arrivals_sd_control.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(mode = "Bus", period = "SD Control")

bus_weekend_non <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "bus_weekend_arrivals_non_control.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(mode = "Bus", period = "Non-control")

mrt_weekend_sd <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "mrt_weekend_arrivals_sd_control.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(mode = "MRT/LRT", period = "SD Control")

mrt_weekend_non <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "mrt_weekend_arrivals_non_control.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(mode = "MRT/LRT", period = "Non-control")
```

```{r}
weekend_arrivals_all <- bind_rows(
  bus_weekend_sd,
  bus_weekend_non,
  mrt_weekend_sd,
  mrt_weekend_non
) %>%
  mutate(
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("SD Control", "Non-control")
    ),
    mode = factor(
      mode,
      levels = c("Bus", "MRT/LRT")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
weekend_attraction_summary <- weekend_arrivals_all %>%
  group_by(mode, period, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_attraction = mean(
      arrival_share_island,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    zone = factor(
      zone,
      levels = c(
        "Woodlands",
        "Tampines",
        "Jurong Lake District",
        "CBD"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
centre_order3 <- c("Woodlands", "Tampines", "Jurong Lake District")
centre_order4 <- c("CBD", "Jurong Lake District", "Tampines", "Woodlands")

poi_type_order <- c(
  "Nightlife",
  "Dining",
  "Retail Shopping",
  "Daily Needs",
  "Family Leisure",
  "Community"
)

land_type_order <- c(
  "Residential& Mixed-Use",
  "Commercial/Business",
  "Leisure/Green",
  "Community/Institutional",
  "Other"
)
```

```{r}
poi_count_data <- poi_counts %>%
  mutate(
    hub = recode(
      hub,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    hub = factor(hub, levels = centre_order3),
    poi_category = str_replace_all(poi_category, "_", " "),
    poi_category = factor(poi_category, levels = poi_type_order)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    hub,
    poi_category,
    fill = list(count = 0)
  )

poi_density_data <- poi_density %>%
  mutate(
    hub = recode(
      hub,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    hub = factor(hub, levels = centre_order3),
    poi_category = str_replace_all(poi_category, "_", " "),
    poi_category = factor(poi_category, levels = poi_type_order)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    hub,
    poi_category,
    fill = list(density_per_km2 = 0)
  )

land_plot_data <- land_use_summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    hub = recode(
      hub,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    hub = factor(
      hub,
      levels = centre_order3
    ),
    land_category = factor(
      as.character(land_category),
      levels = land_type_order
    )
  )

attraction_plot_data <- weekend_arrivals_all %>%
  mutate(
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("SD Control", "Non-control")
    ),
    mode = factor(
      mode,
      levels = c("Bus", "MRT/LRT")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(mode, period, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    attraction_share = mean(arrival_share_island, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    zone = factor(zone, levels = centre_order4)
  )
```

```{r}
p_poi_count <- ggplot(
  poi_count_data,
  aes(
    x = poi_category,
    y = hub,
    size = count
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#4C78A8",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 18,
    name = "POI Count"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(a) POI Count",
    subtitle = "Bubble size indicates the number of POIs",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40")
  )
```

```{r}
density_max <- max(
  poi_density_data$density_per_km2,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

make_heat_strip <- function(hub_name) {
  ggplot(
    filter(poi_density_data, hub == hub_name),
    aes(
      x = poi_category,
      y = hub,
      fill = density_per_km2
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      height = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "C",
      limits = c(0, density_max),
      name = "POI Density\n(POIs/km²)",
      guide = guide_colourbar(
        title.position = "top",
        direction = "horizontal",
        barwidth = unit(4, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(0.5, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "(",
        ifelse(
          hub_name == "Woodlands", "b1",
          ifelse(hub_name == "Tampines", "b2", "b3")
        ),
        ") ",
        hub_name
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 8
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )
}

p_heat_woodlands <- make_heat_strip("Woodlands")
p_heat_tampines  <- make_heat_strip("Tampines")
p_heat_jld       <- make_heat_strip("Jurong Lake District")
```

```{r}
p_heat_combined <- (
  p_heat_woodlands |
  p_heat_tampines |
  p_heat_jld
) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_poi_bundle <- (
  p_poi_count /
  p_heat_combined
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(2.2, 1.2)
  )

p_poi_bundle
```

```{r}
p_landuse <- ggplot(
  land_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = 2,
    y = percentage,
    fill = land_category
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ hub,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(c) Land-use Composition",
    fill = "Land-use Category"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    title.position = "top"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9), 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
p_attraction <- ggplot(
  attraction_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = attraction_share,
    y = zone,
    fill = period
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ mode,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SD Control"  = "#89A9BA",
      "Non-control" = "#D9A46C"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(d) Weekend Public Transport Attraction Share",
    subtitle = "SD Control vs Non-control",
    x = "Share of island-wide trips",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
p_top <- (
  p_poi_bundle | p_landuse
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1)
  )

p_weekend_composite <- (
  p_top / p_attraction
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(2, 1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Weekend Functional Attractiveness of Regional Centres",
    subtitle = "Functional provision, land-use composition and public transport attraction",
    caption = paste0(
      "Note: POI count shows the number of OSM POIs by category; mini heat strips show POI density (POIs/km²). Weekend observations include public holidays.",
      "\nLand-use composition represents the percentage of land area by category. ",
      "Attraction share = arrivals to centre / island-wide trips, averaged across sampled months.\n",
      "Data: OpenStreetMap (2026); URA Master Plan 2019; ",
      "LTA DataMall Bus and MRT/LRT OD (9 SD Control months; 18 Non-control months)."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 17, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.2)
    )
  )

p_weekend_composite
```
